scope: Actual Chromium WebGL2 desktop and phone layouts after a declared restored morning checkpoint one logical metre before the gulf. Original updates physically cross into the ocean. Native W movement, F/context-button holds and Space/DIVE drive signaling, interruption, approach and pickup; no rescue/acknowledgement/damage is injected. Shore riflemen remain the real module-owned actors with actual LOS/tracers. Checkpoint setup bypasses earlier flight/prison/river travel and is not an earned full-campaign outcome. Physical iPhone Safari, hardware FPS and subjective listening quality are untested.
